mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to scrape. Each mode reads ONE of the input lists below. TARGET modes: videos (reads "Feed targets"), video-detail (reads "Video URLs"). QUERY modes: search, discover (both read "Search queries"). CATALOGUE modes need no input at all: channels, taxonomy, polls. LOCATION mode: local-events (reads "Locations").
enumTitles: Videos -- headlines from a category, channel, topic or city
Video detail -- full metadata incl. AI tags and view analytics
Discover -- find channels, cities and topics by keyword
Channels -- the full channel directory (no input needed)
Taxonomy -- categories, live channels and cities (no input needed)
Polls -- every news poll with live vote counts (no input needed)
Local events -- what is happening in a city

targets.title: Feed targets
targets.description: Used by the VIDEOS mode. A full haystack.tv URL or a bare identifier, mixed freely: a category (news, sports, live, weather, business), a channel (channel/abc7), a topic (tag/trump), or a city (location/houston-tx). A bare word with no prefix is read as a category.

videoUrls.title: Video URLs
videoUrls.description: Used by the VIDEO-DETAIL mode. A video page URL (https://www.haystack.tv/v/<slug>), a short id URL (https://www.haystack.tv/id/<id>), or the bare slug or id.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Used by the SEARCH mode (finds videos) and the DISCOVER mode (finds channels, cities and topics). One keyword or phrase per line.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Used by the LOCAL-EVENTS mode. A city slug (houston-tx, new-york-city-ny, san-francisco-ca) or a full https://www.haystack.tv/location/<slug> URL.

maxItemsPerTarget.title: Max videos per target
maxItemsPerTarget.description: Caps how many videos are pushed per feed target or search query. Haystack serves a fixed snapshot of roughly 15-30 videos per feed and offers no deeper pagination, so raising this above ~30 has no effect -- scrape more targets instead.

includeTagGroups.title: Include trending topics
includeTagGroups.description: VIDEOS mode only. Also emit one TAG_GROUP row per trending topic attached to each feed, with how many videos currently carry that topic.

deepLocalEvents.title: Deep local-events harvest
deepLocalEvents.description: LOCAL-EVENTS mode only. Haystack caps anonymous visitors at 10 events per query. Deep mode issues 18 differently-filtered queries per city and de-duplicates, which raises a typical city from 10 to roughly 60-70 events at 18x the request cost. Turn off for a fast 10-event sample.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent requests
maxConcurrency.description: How many targets to process in parallel. Haystack has no anti-bot layer, but keep this modest to stay a polite client.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. haystack.tv has no anti-bot protection and the actor runs fine with no proxy at all. Use a US residential or datacenter proxy if you want the personalised My Headlines feed (the bare / target) to be geo-located to the US.
